title: MintMC
description: Great perfomance, beautiful graphics and astonishing world generation
body:
### Optimized experience

This modpack brings excellent performance out of the box. Powered by **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, and others the pack runs smoothly even on mid-range systems.

---

### World Reimagined

Explore beutiful terrain thanks to **Terralith**, **Nullscape**, **Biomes O' Plenty**, and **Distant Horizons** — seamlessly blended for epic landscapes across all three dimensions. Villages are also more alive with **ChoiceTheorem’s Overhauled Village**.

---
### Player-side QoL

MintMC also features **BetterF3**, **Xaero’s maps**, **Traveler’s Backpack** and other QoL mods

---
### As for Immersive atmosphere..

..this modpack brings **Falling leaves**, **AmbientSounds**, **Sound Physics Remastered**, and etc

---

### IMPORTANT
I changed some keybinds in **Traveler's Backpack** mod in order for **Zoomify** to work.
